reason: I'd rather have someone on the team or an intern do a small task than set up a Solana wallet and pay 55 USDC for a contest where maybe nobody wins. It's not worth the hassle for a small job.
objection: Paying in USDC on Solana means a wallet and crypto handling just to buy a small task, and it's an unaudited new product that only lets in invited organisations. I'd also pay a fee for sealed entries where most of the entrants get nothing, and I don't trust an AI judge to pick what I'd actually pick.
would_change_my_mind: Let me pay by card or invoice with no wallet, and show me a few finished tasks where the AI judge's winner was clearly good. I'd still try the free task if the team really sets it up for me.
